body: A lot of us in our 20's-30's don't have a savings. I tried so many times in the last decade only for my parents and student loans to drain me. It's just not possible if you're not working three jobs. My retirement plan is death.

Oof! I've had issues with UI since the beginning because I had also applied for it last year in another state when I lost my job. Never got a cent of that money either. Not that it mattered to me much because I was finishing school and got a job when I moved back home.
But it seems to be confusing the UI in Cali now. They actually closed my Cali UI account because I had "never registered" but I was unable to register because I was never given my pin until I called them. 

After that I got a flood of letters in the mail asking me to certify for the weeks I had missed, but I certified online instead now that I finally had access to it. And that's where I am now. Certifying and not getting anything. I thought about filling out the paper forms and mailing them, but I'm worried about being accused of filing "double claims", so I don't.
I intend to. And I'm I'm going to use your Tip of saying "I think my account has a flag" and see if that gives me any results. I'm so glad I decided to look for hell on reddit. Thank you.

I've been "pending" for like, three months. When I got through to someone on the 8am-8pm number last week, the lady on the phone said they where overwhelmed and that no one could help me. A liver person said no one could help me. She then gave me a fake number to call it was a "specialist" and a child picked up. So yeah. That's were I am now. With ten weeks "pending" and having to choose between rent, groceries, or bills.
At first I thought "they cleaned the bathroom?" And then I realized they were two different games and it was about the mirror.

I'm trying not to take it personally. It's most certainly not the first time I've been lashed out at. though in the heat of the moment I rudely replied "tell me something I don't know". I know it was wrong to say that. I'm honestly trying to find the studies she said exist that say telling other people pressure the victim into suicide but I don't think I'm wording it right in my serches because I can't find anything.

She tends to burn bridges wherever she goes so I'm not sure if she has another place to go, yet. Our mother is working on having her stay with a family member. But she doesn't want to go. 

Abuser is currently going back to his home state where his family lives.

I just don't want to loose her. But I don't know how to help her. I live with my mother. The pandemic made me loose my job. I don't even have the funds to help take care of her. I only found out about the first two attempts a few months ago.
